entitySuffixRule: The name shall end with the phrase "limited liability company" or "limited company" or the abbreviation "LLC" or "LC." A professional limited liability company's name shall end with "professional limited liability company," "professional limited company," "PLLC," or "PLC." In either name the word "limited" may be abbreviated "Ltd." and the word "company" may be abbreviated "Co."
distinguishabilityNote: The real name of an entity or foreign entity must be distinguishable from any name of record with the Secretary of State, which KRS 14A.1-070(21) defines as any real, fictitious, reserved, registered, or assumed name of an entity or foreign entity. The only exception in the section is the real name of a general partnership under subsection (24). The section sets out no consent route for a name that is not distinguishable.
nameReservationCostBasis: The $15 Secretary of State fee for an application or renewal of an application for a reserved name (KRS 14A.2-060(1)(b)) is the full cost.
notes: Kentucky keeps entity name standards in the Business Entity Filing Act (KRS Chapter 14A), which every entity type shares. KRS 275.100, the naming section of the LLC Act, states no rule of its own: it says only that the name of each limited liability company shall satisfy the requirements of KRS 14A.3-010. The LLC designator list is KRS 14A.3-010(3) and the distinguishability test is KRS 14A.3-010(1). "Cooperative" may not be used in the name of any entity doing business in the Commonwealth except as that section otherwise provides (subsection (13)). "Bank," "banker," "banking" and "trust" are barred by KRS 286.3-027 to anyone not authorized both to use the term and to conduct the business, on a civil penalty of $1,000 to $5,000 per violation, and insurer names are screened separately by the Department of Insurance under KRS 304.3-100. A reservation runs 120 days and may be renewed for a further 120 days by applying during the 30 days before it expires. Kentucky's LLC formation fee is one of the lowest in the country at $40.
